name: Quang Trung
role: Tây Sơn commander, later emperor of Đại Việt
known_facts: One of the three Tây Sơn brothers who rose in revolt from Bình Định in 1771
Destroyed the Siamese expeditionary force at Rạch Gầm - Xoài Mút in 1785
Marched north in 1786 and ended the power of the Trịnh lords
Proclaimed himself Emperor Quang Trung in 1788 before the northern campaign
Defeated the Qing army at Ngọc Hồi - Đống Đa during Tết Kỷ Dậu, 1789
Died in 1792 at about forty, after which the Tây Sơn state declined
interpretation: Late-18th-century Đại Việt commander and emperor, based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
Exact birth year (1752 or 1753) and cause of death are uncertain
